min.$description: 44px. Effective touch target of any interactive control on a coarse pointer (mobile-first floor). The visual box may be smaller (down to target.floor); an invisible hit area extends it to this size.

floor.$description: 24px. WCAG 2.5.8 AA visual target-size floor. The smallest a control may render (SJButton xs); on a coarse pointer the effective target is target.min.

width.$description: 2px. Thickness of the focus indicator edge, matching the indigo edge of shadow.focus (WCAG 2.4.13 area).

offset.$description: 2px. Gap between the control and the focus indicator edge, matching the white gap of shadow.focus.

text-min.$description: 16px. Minimum font size of any text-entry control, so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus.

xs.$description: 24px. Compact control height (SJButton xs). Equals the WCAG 2.5.8 visual floor; the effective touch target is extended to target.min on coarse pointers.

md.$description: 36px. Default control height (SJButton md). A compact step between space.8 and space.10.

lg.$description: 44px. Large control height (SJButton lg). Meets the touch target without a hit-area extension.

xs.$description: 8px. Inline padding of an xs control.

sm.$description: 12px. Inline padding of an sm control.

md.$description: 14px. Inline padding of an md control; between space.3 and space.4.

lg.$description: 20px. Inline padding of an lg control.

xs.$description: 12px. Label size of an xs control.

sm.$description: 13px. Label size of an sm control; between font.size.xs and font.size.sm.

md.$description: 14px. Label size of an md control.

lg.$description: 15px. Label size of an lg control; between font.size.sm and font.size.base.

xs.$description: 4px. Gap between icon and label in an xs control.

sm.$description: 6px. Gap between icon and label in an sm control.

md.$description: 6px. Gap between icon and label in an md control.

lg.$description: 8px. Gap between icon and label in an lg control.

xs.$description: 14px. Glyph box inside an xs control.

sm.$description: 16px. Glyph box inside an sm control.

md.$description: 16px. Glyph box inside an md control.

lg.$description: 18px. Glyph box inside an lg control.

underline-thickness.$description: 1px. Underline of a link-variant control at rest (SJButton variant link). Underlined at rest so the link never relies on color alone.

underline-thickness-hover.$description: 2px. Underline of a link-variant control on hover and press. The underline thickens; the box never moves.

underline-offset.$description: Gap between the text and the underline of a link-variant control. Relative to the font size, so it follows the surrounding sentence.

margin.$description: Scroll margin for scrollIntoView of an active or focused item, so sticky or fixed bars never obscure it (WCAG 2.4.11).

hairline.$description: The one documented raw 1px hairline. Dividers and input outlines; never for focus or emphasis.
